z_cl.quote: In this paper, we measure distances at the redshift of the cluster, $z=0.296$, by assuming an $\Omega_\mathrm{m} =0.3, \lambda =0.7, H_0=70\mathrm{km/s/Mpc}$ cosmology which results in $4.413$ kpc/$\arcsec$ plate-scale.

I.type: weak-lensing kappa peak of the subcluster (2D kappa reconstruction; peak detected at 8 sigma)

offset.derivation: sqrt(7.1^2 + 6.5^2) = 9.63 arcsec, computed by extractor from the two stated components; the paper does not state the total
offset.reference_point: the subcluster's brightest cluster galaxy (BCG) = Table 2 row 'Subcluster BCG'

I.quote: Two major peaks are clearly visible in the reconstruction, one centered $7\farcs1$ east and $6\farcs5$ north of the subcluster's brightest cluster galaxy (BCG) and detected at $8\sigma$ significance

uncertainty_context.note: No numerical centroid error is stated. Bootstrap centroid errors are only shown as contours in Fig. 1 (68.3/95.5/99.7%). The text gives only significance multiples of the (unstated) sigma.
uncertainty_context.quote: We estimate centroid uncertainties by repeating bootstrap samplings of the background galaxy catalog, performing a $\kappa$ reconstruction with the resampled catalogs, and measuring the centroid of each peak.  Both peaks are offset from their respective BCG by $\sim 2\sigma$, but are within $1\sigma$ of the luminosity centroid of the respective component's galaxies (both BCGs are slightly offset from the center of galaxy concentrations).  Both peaks are also offset at $\sim 8\sigma$ from the center of mass of their respective plasma clouds.
uncertainty_context.fig1_caption_quote: The white contours show the errors on the positions of the $\kappa$ peaks and correspond to $68.3\%$, $95.5\%$, and $99.7\%$ confidence levels.

notes: Positions are in Table 2 of the arXiv source (Table 1 = optical imaging sets), contrary to the pointer 'Table 1'. Kappa peak given only as an offset (7.1" E, 6.5" N) from the subcluster BCG; total 9.63" is derived by the extractor. If an absolute I position is wanted it follows from BCG + offset (extractor-derived, not in paper: approx RA 06:58:16.85, Dec -55:56:28.6, using cos(dec)=0.560). No numerical positional uncertainty for I, G or S is stated anywhere in the paper; no instrument centroiding error is stated. Only the qualitative statements '~2 sigma from BCG' (implies sigma ~ 4.8" if taken literally, NOT stated by the paper), 'within 1 sigma of the luminosity centroid', and '~8 sigma from the centre of mass of the plasma clouds'. Ambiguity: the text calls the plasma positions 'X-ray plasma peaks' (Table 2 paragraph) while §3 uses 'center of mass of their respective plasma clouds' for the 8-sigma offset; the Table 2 position is the only plasma coordinate given. Platescale stated: 4.413 kpc/arcsec (their cosmology). Luminosity centroid is not tabulated, so per protocol the BCG is the S position.
